results.explanation: In doSomething, the condition (7 * 42) - 106 > 200 evaluates to 188 > 200, which is false, returning the tainted user input stored in param. This input is concatenated directly into a shell command string passed to ProcessBuilder via cmd.exe /c or sh -c, enabling command injection.
